empty.title: No worker nodes registered yet.
empty.hint: To add a remote worker, run the same Docker image with SHRINKERR_MODE=worker

setup.title: Add a remote worker
setup.intro: Run the same Shrinkerr Docker image on another machine with these environment variables:
setup.footer: The worker will auto-detect GPU capabilities and appear here within 30 seconds. Media directories must be mounted at the same paths (or configure PATH_MAPPINGS).

card.removeConfirmWorking: Remove node "{{name}}"? Its current job will be released back to the queue.

pause.title: Pause
pause.hint: When paused, this node won't pick up new jobs. Already-running jobs continue.

parallel.title: Parallel jobs
parallel.hint: Max number of jobs this node processes concurrently.

affinity.title: Job affinity
affinity.hint: Control what jobs this node accepts. Useful for dedicating the Mac to CPU-only work or forcing NVENC jobs to the GPU node.

translation.title: Encoder translation
translation.hint: When enabled, this node will transparently translate jobs between NVENC and libx265 based on its own capabilities.
translation.both: Translate jobs between NVENC and libx265

token.title: Auth token
token.hint: Remote workers authenticate with a per-node shared secret on top of the global API key. Rotating invalidates the current token; the worker re-bootstraps on its next heartbeat.
token.none: No token yet — next heartbeat will bootstrap one.
token.rotateConfirm:
Rotate this node's auth token?

The server will invalidate the current token immediately. The worker will drop its cached copy on the next 401 and automatically re-bootstrap a fresh token on its next heartbeat. In-flight jobs on this node will fail and be requeued.
token.rotated: Token rotated. The worker will re-bootstrap on its next heartbeat.

paths.title: Path mappings
paths.hint: Translate paths between what the server dispatches and what the worker sees on disk. Most setups don't need this if the worker's -v mounts match the server's layout 1:1.
paths.reported: Reported by worker (from PATH_MAPPINGS env var):
paths.help: Paths must be absolute (start with /). Translation is applied when the server dispatches a job to this node: each mapping's server prefix is rewritten to its worker prefix before the worker sees the path.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hint: Restrict when this node accepts jobs. When disabled, the node runs 24/7.
schedule.clickHours: Click hours when this node is allowed to process jobs:
schedule.noHours: No hours selected — node will never run while schedule is enabled
